item.title: Person objects decorated with /photos/{id} instead of /people/{id} URLs
item.justification: URL decoration (_decorate_single_item) generates incorrect `/photos/{id}` URLs for person objects, when they should generate `/people/{id}` URLs. This occurs when person objects returned from endpoints like /search/* or /people endpoints have only an "id" field (not "personId") and lack an explicit "type": "PERSON" field. The inference logic in _detect_response_type() falls back to treating them as assets (since they have "id" but no distinguishing ID field like "personId" or "albumId"), resulting in broken web UI links for people. This undermines the usability improvement from URL decoration items 46-48.

item.title: Warn when credentials are sent over plain HTTP
